recipes.name: @patchworkos/morning-brief
recipes.description: Daily 6am digest: Gmail unread, Linear assigned issues, Slack DMs, and today's calendar — composed into one Slack message.

recipes.name: @patchworkos/incident-war-room
recipes.description: Ops incident response: summarize alert, open Linear issue, post to #incidents Slack, then append post-incident summary to Notion.

recipes.name: @patchworkos/sprint-review-prep
recipes.description: Pull completed Linear issues for the current sprint, summarize with AI, post digest to #engineering Slack channel.

recipes.name: @patchworkos/customer-escalation
recipes.description: Zendesk ticket escalation pipeline: fetch ticket, create linked Linear issue, alert #support-escalations on Slack.

recipes.name: @patchworkos/deal-won-celebration
recipes.description: HubSpot deal closed-won trigger: celebrate in #wins Slack, log deal details to a Notion database.

recipes.name: @patchworkos/end-of-day-shutdown
recipes.description: Weekday 6pm shutdown digest: open Linear issues, unread Slack DMs, and tomorrow's calendar — composed into a 4-line Slack message.

recipes.name: @patchworkos/standup-digest
recipes.description: Weekday 9am standup post: yesterday's closed Linear issues plus today's in-progress work, composed into a 3-line yesterday/today/blockers update for Slack.

recipes.name: @patchworkos/friday-recap
recipes.description: Friday 4pm weekly recap: closed Linear issues, calendar load, and active Slack threads — composed into a wins/losses summary posted to Slack and optionally appended to a Notion weekly log.

recipes.name: @kungfuk3nnyyy/weekly-commit-report
recipes.description: Every Monday: fetch an employee's GitHub commits for the past 7 days and produce a structured contribution report with themes, stats, and highlights. Optionally pushes to phone via ntfy.sh.
